description: Analyze a single reference screenshot into structured data an agent can build from: layout regions (position/size), dominant colors, typography, spacing, a suggested implementation strategy, and a `rulers` block of deterministic projection measurements (background-zone band heights, content-column edges + widths, gutter widths) — build to these exact values to get sizing/spacing right the first time. Returns a compact summary by default; set full=true for the complete report. Input is an image file path.

disable_ocr.description: Skip OCR text extraction. OCR runs by default and roughly doubles latency; disable it when you don't need text content or typography (note: extract then returns empty fontSizes).

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio of the screenshot (pass 2 for a Retina/Mac capture). When set, the compact report's font sizes and region bounds are returned in CSS pixels instead of raw image pixels. Auto-detected when omitted, but passing it is more reliable.

fine.description: Use fine-grained (4px) layout detection for small details.

full.description: Return the full detailed report instead of the compact summary.

image_path.description: Path (absolute, or relative to the server's launch directory) to the screenshot to analyze.

name: extract
title: Extract structured design data from a screenshot
